subject: Subprocessor inventory, export classification and DPA annex request
messages:
From: Starlight Pay Compliance <compliance@starlightpay.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Subprocessor inventory and export classification request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. Procurement is running the vendor DDQ and we need a consolidated subprocessor inventory and export classification so our security and legal teams can complete the review. Specifically: 

- Full list of subprocessors (name, role, countries where they process or store logs)
- Whether any subprocessor has access to plaintext request/response logs or K/V caches
- KMS/HSM provider and jurisdiction for any key material used for customer data
- Export classification: do any subprocessors replicate or transfer EU-origin data outside the EU?
- Copies of the DPA and any current addenda or export annexes you can share

We attached our DDQ PDF (see attachment). Our procurement deadline is close: can you confirm by EOD 2026-05-13 if possible?

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Compliance Lead, Starlight Pay
Attachments: starlight-pay-ddq.pdf

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Starlight Pay Compliance <compliance@starlightpay.com>, Starlight Pay Procurement <procurement@starlightpay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory and export classification request

Hi Marta / Starlight team,

Appreciate the note — we can absolutely provide a consolidated inventory and the export classification matrix. High-level summary below and I"ll attach the working CSV for your intake team.

TL;DR (overview):
- We maintain a living subprocessor roster; most telemetry and analytics subprocessors operate in the US and EU; storage/transit partners have onshore options where required.
- No subprocessor has direct access to long-term plaintext customer prompts outside of intentionally-configured logging paths (we can provide examples).
- KMS: we use a mix of cloud KMS (customer-region keys where customers opt in) and a Redwood-managed HSM for internal platform keys. Jurisdictions are listed in the CSV.

Action plan / next steps:
1) Attached: redwood-subprocessor-inventory.csv (working copy) — contains name, role, country coverage, data types processed, notes on KMS/HSM and whether logs are retained off-region.
2) Legal: Jordan / Kim — can you review and confirm if we should send the DPA addendum (EU export appendix) or the full DPA copy to Starlight?
3) Olga -> provide finalized export appendix and per-country matrix by 2026-05-14 EOD if that works for your timeline.

Attachment: redwood-subprocessor-inventory.csv

Let me know if you want a short call to walk the matrix; happy to set up 30 minutes with engineering/ops.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Privacy & Trust | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0131

From: Starlight Pay Procurement <procurement@starlightpay.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Starlight Pay Compliance <compliance@starlightpay.com>, Contracts <contracts@starlightpay.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory and export classification request

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the working CSV — procurement is reviewing. A few clarifying asks so we can sign off with our security team: 

- We need explicit export classifications for the following jurisdictions: China, Russia, and any APAC islands where you may have third-party caching. If any subprocessor synchronizes logs to a US-only analytics stack, please mark that clearly.
- For KMS/HSM: can you confirm whether customer-encrypted customer keys are ever escrowed in the US HSM? We require confirmation that customer-managed keys do not leave customer region unless explicitly requested.
- Is there a DPA addendum (export appendix) you can share that maps subprocessors -> transfer safeguards? If not, we"ll need that in writing to meet our procurement policy.

Procurement deadline: we need the final artifacts (matrix + DPA addendum or confirmation) by noon PT on 2026-05-15 to keep our renewal cycle on track. Attaching the procurement timeline here.

Regards,
Ethan Moore
Vendor Ops Manager, Starlight Pay
Attachments: procurement-timeline.xlsx

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Starlight Pay Procurement <procurement@starlightpay.com>, Starlight Pay Compliance <compliance@starlightpay.com>, Contracts <contracts@starlightpay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Subprocessor inventory and export classification request

Ethan / Marta,

Thanks — and appreciate the timeline. Quick answers and commitments below, followed by attachments with the detailed matrix and the draft addendum.

Quick clarifications (high level):
- China / Russia / APAC caching: We do not operate Redwood-managed on-prem caching in mainland China or Russia. A small subset of telemetry caching partners have presence in APAC (Singapore, Japan); those rows are flagged in the attached CSV. No subprocessors replicate EU-origin prompts to Russia or China.
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys (when customers choose BYOK) remain in the chosen region and are not escrowed to Redwood-managed HSM unless expressly configured in a contract addendum. Our standard offering keeps customer keys regional-only. Internal platform keys are held in a Redwood-managed HSM (US jurisdiction).
- Logs / plaintext: By default we redact sensitive prompt data in telemetry pipelines; full request/response retention is only enabled via explicit customer configuration and is documented in the inventory notes column.

Commitments / deliverables: 
1) Attached: subproc-country-matrix.csv — per-subprocessor country footprint and transfer classification.
2) Attached: subproc-eu-export-appendix.pdf — draft DPA addendum that maps subprocessors to transfer safeguards and clarifies onshore fallback/escrow options.
3) Jordan will follow up on any legal redlines. Kimberly, Naomi: please confirm the timeline for signed addendum and whether procurement needs a stamped PDF.

We aim to deliver any redline-ready DPA addendum within 3 business days (i.e., by 2026-05-19) and can provide an interim signed statement for procurement by 2026-05-15 noon PT if that helps keep the renewal.

Attachments: subproc-country-matrix.csv, subproc-eu-export-appendix.pdf

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Privacy & Trust | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0131
